product_family: Clockwise is an AI-powered calendar and scheduling assistant that optimizes team calendars, protects focus time, and automates meeting scheduling. The product includes features for intelligent meeting coordination, travel time management, meeting breaks, and scheduling links.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Clockwise is now SOC 2 Type II compliant! Clockwise earned SOC 2 Type II compliance by achieving service commitments and system requirements based on the trust services criteria relevant to security, as defined by the AICPA.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27001 certification on vendor domain. AWS infrastructure (hosting provider) maintains ISO 27001, but this is not Clockwise's own certification.

certifications.name: GDPR

privacy.ai_training_note: No evidence that Clockwise trains AI models on customer calendar data. Privacy policy states 'Clockwise may create aggregated, de-identified or anonymized data from the personal data collected and share it with third parties for lawful business purposes, including to analyze, build and improve the services, provided that they will not share such data in a manner that could identify you.' Calendar data is not directly used for marketing or third-party advertising.

products.name: Clockwise Calendar Assistant
products.data_scope: Reads calendar event titles, descriptions, participant info, meeting times, travel needs, and time zone preferences to optimize schedules
products.notes: AI-powered scheduling tool for individuals and teams; integrates with Google Calendar and Microsoft Outlook; provides focus time blocking, meeting optimization, and scheduling links

compare.data_residency: AWS-hosted, supports GDPR/CCPA data residency requirements

flags: Clockwise was acquired by Salesforce in early 2026, and the service is being shut down on March 27, 2026. As of July 6, 2026, the product is no longer available and all customer data will be deleted.
Website pages have been converted to shutdown notices; blog and support documentation are no longer publicly accessible.
Only SOC 2 Type II certification could be directly verified from vendor domain. Other certs (ISO 27001, HIPAA, FedRAMP, CSA STAR) mentioned in third-party sources but not confirmed on vendor domain.
DPA page accessible but limited details; full privacy and security documentation no longer prominently featured due to shutdown.
Nudge Security's aggregator profile lists HIPAA, FedRAMP, and CSA STAR Level 1, but no direct vendor-domain evidence was found for these certifications.
AWS infrastructure maintains ISO 27001, but Clockwise's own ISO 27001 certification status unclear (vendor cert vs. infrastructure cert distinction).
